gizmo.title: Kusaka mawu
gizmo.description: Gululi la zilembo lokhala ndi mawu obisika. Ophunzira amadina chilembo choyamba ndi chomaliza cha liwu lililonse. Limayeserera kuzindikira momwe liwu limalembedwera, osati tanthauzo lake.

configure.title: Mutu
configure.description: Zomwe ophunzira afunsidwa kupeza, zowonetsedwa pamutu.

configure.title: Mawu
configure.description: Mawu oti abisidwe. Mipata ndi zizindikiro za kalembedwe zimasiyidwa m'gululi. Mawu omwe sakukwanira amalembedwa pamene mukusintha ndipo amasiyidwa kwa ophunzira.

advanced.title: Kukula kwa gululi
advanced.description: Zilembo pa mbali iliyonse, 4 mpaka 16. Siyani chopanda kanthu kuti likwanire liwu lalitali kwambiri (mpaka 12). Kupitirira 12 kumapukusika m'mbali pa foni.

advanced.title: Mawu obwerera
advanced.description: Bisaninso mawu olembedwa mobwerera. Zovuta kwambiri.

advanced.title: Mtundu wowonetsa
advanced.description: Mtundu wosankha wa chizindikiro cha pamutu, chilembo choyamba chosankhidwa ndi batani.
